The first expedition

Mercy has a cost.
Ruin has a memory.

Book I

The Eightfold Covenant

The Mercy
of Ruin

He walked away from the law to escape his past. Then the past came looking for him.

When raiders burn Zion's Vale, former Sentinel Jovan Ga'al emerges from the flames with a mysterious medallion - and a forbidden power he once spent years policing. Far away, sheltered Dreamer Eazra Horama sees an impossible darkness spreading through visions of a forgotten age.

As their paths converge, ancient relics resurface, old enemies begin to move, and the magic civilization depends upon reveals a darker cost.

02

Behind the stories

I have always been drawn to the places where character is tested.

I'm Michael Eidson - a U.S. Navy veteran, former combat journalist, criminal investigator, endurance athlete, outdoorsman, and now novelist.

My stories draw from classic Westerns, military history, and mythology. I write about dangerous frontiers, buried truths, and broken people discovering they are still capable of extraordinary things.

Michael Eidson
